versions.changelog:
**Major update: Adds deep visual reports, exact number quoting, and implications section.**

- Full paper text is now always extracted (not just the abstract) when possible.
- Reports now quote all exact numbers (N, trials, effect sizes, p-values, etc.) directly from the original paper.
- A mechanism/method diagram (inline SVG) visually illustrates the study's core paradigm.
- Report is delivered as both markdown and a polished, fully self-contained HTML file.
- New section: "Implications for the reader’s research" offers 3–5 concrete actionable insights.
- Enhanced model-comparison tables/charts; stricter completeness checks before output.
- Removed the example skill card file (skill-card.md).

Initial release of the literature-deep-read-report skill.

- Automatically generates a structured deep-read report for academic papers, covering seven key components: background, variables, paradigm/method, task flow, design details, statistical analysis, and main results.
- Triggers when a user provides an academic paper or citation and requests an in-depth summary or literature report.
- Acquires paper text from local PDF, DOI/arXiv/PubMed link, or title search, degrading gracefully if only the abstract is available.
- Ensures outputs are consistently formatted, with verbatim numbers/terms and clear source marking for inferred content.
- Adds a one-line summary and a limitations/reproducibility section to each report.
